scope.objective: Align the live serial-runtime-to-parallel-risk boundary to the blueprint so that serial runtime emits the admitted packet set, parallel risk consumes bounded packet inputs only, and parallel risk emits lawful DMPV3 output.

Parallel risk ingress consumes only the admitted bounded packet inputs required by the blueprint.
Parallel risk output remains a lawful DMPV3 packet.
One deterministic end-to-end route is proved and the tranche stops there.
non_goals: Upstream DMP expansion above the serial runtime boundary

code_refs.claim: `run_from_serial_runtime(...)` consumes the serial runtime receipt, selects the temporal stage packet only, derives both downstream packet ids internally from the temporal packet id seed, and fails closed on prefix contract mismatch.

Bootstrap stage-read state explicitly admits temporal for live semantic read from the serial runtime boundary and marks non-temporal serial packets as not admitted for live semantic read in this tranche.
The bootstrap adapter translates the selected serial-runtime temporal stage packet into the bounded bootstrap packet while preserving lineage from the selected temporal stage packet only.
Temporal output is projected into the existing bounded bootstrap payload shape without widening the carrier surface.
The specimen harness writes exactly six retained artefacts under the new bounded specimen home.
The lane-service proof asserts exact internally derived packet ids and closed-fail behaviour on temporal packet id contract mismatch.
